[Commits to Master Since This Release](https://github.com/itsrody/uBlockFox/compare/%version%...master)

- **Firefox 160+**: Download the unsigned XPI from [uBlock0_%version%.firefox.xpi](https://github.com/itsrody/uBlockFox/releases/download/%version%/uBlock0_%version%.firefox.xpi)
  Requires native Firefox 160 or later (Manifest V2 extension API) configured to
  allow unsigned add-ons. Install and update manually; there is no AMO listing or
  automatic update channel.
